U.S. B-1 bombers evacuated from UK base after attack threats from Iran
market.summary: The U.S. military evacuated a dozen B-1 bombers from the RAF Fairford airbase in the UK over the weekend, the Pentagon said. Why it matters: A U.S. official said the base was under threat of attack by Iran. Driving the news: British security forces last week arrested several dual British-Iranian citizens suspected of planning an attack on the base. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel gave the UK intelligence that pointed to a threat of an Iranian attack. What they're saying: "While operational security precluded us from confirming the movement of our assets and forces in real-time, we can acknowledge now that all U.S. bombers that were deployed to RAF Fairford have re-deployed to their home stations in the United States," the Pentagon said in a statement. It added that the U.S. military bomber force, including B-1s, B-2s, and B-52s, "remain ready to deliver precision global strike capabilities — including through operations that launch and recover from the continental United States."

The lawsuit claims the company failed to disclose that FDA study design concerns were not addressed and that submitted data from an early analysis included only 40 of 400 planned patients, likely causing FDA rejection of the BLA. Investors who purchased securities between October 20, 2025 and April 10, 2026 can apply to be lead plaintiff by October 5, 2026.

AAOI.title: October FOMC: Why the Fed Will Pause
AAOI.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to pause rate hikes at its October 27-28 meeting despite recent inflation concerns. A slower pace of rate hikes is generally bullish for equities, particularly AI-related stocks.

DAL.title: Delta Air Lines (DAL) Earnings Expected to Grow: Should You Buy?
DAL.summary: Delta Air Lines is expected to report Q3 2026 earnings of $1.96 per share (up 14.6% YoY) with revenues of $17.7 billion (up 6.2% YoY) on October 9. However, the stock carries a negative Earnings ESP of -2.81% and a Zacks Rank #5, making it unlikely to beat consensus estimates. While Delta has beaten estimates in 4 of the last 4 quarters, recent analyst revisions have turned bearish, suggesting challenging near-term stock performance.

XOM.title: Can Chevron's Growing LNG Network Power Its Next Growth Phase?
XOM.summary: Chevron is building a diversified natural gas strategy with LNG operations spanning Australia, Asia Pacific, the Eastern Mediterranean, and West Africa. The company's Australian assets (Gorgon and Wheatstone) supply 40% of Western Australia's domestic gas and 9.5M tons annually to Japan, while U.S. Gulf Coast capacity has reached 7M tons annually with volumes beginning in 2026. Industry peers ExxonMobil and Shell are similarly investing in LNG as a long-term growth avenue, with Shell targeting 4-5% annual LNG sales growth through 2030.

XOM.title: Is First Trust NASDAQ Oil & Gas ETF (FTXN) a Strong ETF Right Now?
XOM.summary: FTXN is a smart beta ETF providing exposure to US oil and gas companies with $970.56 million in assets. It tracks the Nasdaq US Smart Oil & Gas Index with a 0.60% expense ratio and 1.84% dividend yield. The fund returned 41.33% overall and 38.71% year-to-date as of October 2026, with top holdings including ConocoPhillips, Chevron, and ExxonMobil. However, cheaper alternatives like VDE (0.09% expense ratio) and XLE (0.08% expense ratio) offer lower-cost market-cap weighted energy exposure.

PFIX.title: 4 Best-Performing ETFs of September
PFIX.summary: In September, despite broader market weakness, several ETFs outperformed driven by specific market themes. Oil funds also benefited from Middle East tensions.

DXCM.summary: Dexcom released its 2026 State of Type 2 Report highlighting significant gaps in CGM awareness and reimbursement access, with 55% of Type 2 diabetes patients having limited knowledge of the technology. However, the report reveals substantial growth opportunities as 58% of Type 2 patients on GLP-1 medicines use CGM, and a majority are open to CGM when recommended alongside GLP-1 therapy. Competitors Abbott Laboratories and MiniMed are also expanding their CGM portfolios with innovative features and sensor technologies.

YSS.title: YSS Investors Have Opportunity to Lead York Space Systems, Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
YSS.summary: Schall, Brown & Schwartz LLP announced a class action securities fraud lawsuit against York Space Systems, Inc. (NYSE: YSS) for making false and misleading statements during its January 2026 IPO. The company allegedly failed to achieve fully functional mission and payload software before satellite launches, putting contracts with the SDA at risk. Investors who purchased shares between January 29, 2026 and May 11, 2026 are encouraged to participate, with a deadline of October 30, 2026.

NVS.summary: Europe's cancer metabolism-based therapeutics market is projected to grow from $1.12 billion in 2026 to $8.54 billion by 2035, representing a 25.3% CAGR. ARES.title: Can Lazard's Asset Management Growth Power Its 2030 Revenue Goal?

RPD.title: Rapid7 Launches Rapid7 Intelligence to Harness Threat Data Against Attackers

The company faces significant risks including heavy dependence on Amazon and Google (47% of revenues), massive fixed compute commitments of $1.25 billion monthly, and customer concentration with two unnamed clients each representing 12% of revenues. While Anthropic projects $190-200 billion in 2028 revenues and could reach profitability in Q3 2026, its circular economic relationship with Big Tech competitors and fixed costs against variable revenues pose ongoing challenges.
